One [[Seer Artifact Chest]] can be found in [[The Last Vault]] of the [[Lost Basilica]]. It becomes accessible after the [[The Basilica Vaults]] [[meta event]], and can be opened once per day per account.

== Location ==
;[[Castora]]
* [[Starlit Weald]]
** [[Lost Basilica]]

== Contents ==
* {{gather|Piece of Common Unidentified Gear|qty=3|chance=guaranteed}} <small>(or better)</small> <small>(drops separately)</small>
* {{gather|Piece of Unidentified Gear|qty=1-2|chance=guaranteed}} <small>(or better)</small> <small>(drops separately)</small>
** Each drop also has a chance to be upgraded to 2-3.
* {{gather|Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear|qty=1|chance=guaranteed}} <small>(or better)</small>
* Additionally with {{effect|Obscured Riches}} mastery:
** {{gather|Raw Enchanting Stone|qty=3|notes=requires [[Obscured Riches]] mastery|chance=guaranteed}}
** {{gather|Unusual Coin|qty=7-10|notes=requires [[Obscured Riches]] mastery|chance=guaranteed}}
** Chance to roll again on the gear drops above, effectively doubling its contents (aside from currencies).
